X-WING REMAKE - vertical slice (Windows)
========================================

Double-click XWing.exe. Keep this folder together: XWing.exe needs the data_ folder next to it.
If Windows SmartScreen warns about an unrecognized app: More info -> Run anyway (the build is not code-signed).
If it says your video card does not support Vulkan, use "Play (compatibility mode).bat".

MISSION: You are Red 1. Protect the corvette Valiant from two waves of TIE fighters,
then press H to jump to hyperspace once the HUD says objectives are complete.

CONTROLS
  Arrow keys ........ pitch / yaw (down arrow = nose up)
  Q / E ............. roll
  Space ............. fire lasers          X ..... fire-link (single/dual/quad)
  R ................. target nearest enemy  T / Y . next / previous target
  [  ]  \  Backspace  throttle 1/3, 2/3, full, stop      = / - .. throttle +/-
  F9 / F10 .......... laser / shield recharge (costs engine speed)
  S ................. shield focus (even / front / rear)
  ; / apostrophe .... move energy lasers->shields / shields->lasers
  H ................. hyperspace           V ..... cockpit / chase view
  M ................. music on/off         P ..... pause    F5 .. restart    Esc .. quit
  Gamepad ........... left stick fly, A fire, B nearest target, Y next target, LB/RB throttle

TIPS: drop to 1/3 throttle in a dogfight (tightest turns). Watch the FORE/AFT scopes.
Leaving before the objectives are complete fails the mission.

Watch the AI fly it: run  XWing.exe -- --autopilot  from a command prompt.
